title: Lamine Yamal: Understanding His Famous Goal and Making Your Own AI Football Clip
metaTitle: Lamine Yamal Goal Explained and AI Football Video Guide | Ozil Goal
description: From his Barcelona debut to his curling strike against France at EURO 2024, explore Lamine Yamal’s memorable moments and learn how to make an AI football clip from your own portrait.
label: Lamine Yamal’s Famous Goal
excerpt: Revisit Yamal’s curling EURO strike and discover what real match highlights and personal AI football clips each offer.
intro: When you search for **Lamine Yamal**, you may want to know who he is, or you may be looking for that curling shot against France. Understanding the moment means looking at the score and his decisions before the strike, as well as the finish itself. This article starts with documented match records, then explains how to turn your interest in football into an AI clip starring you.

sections.title: From Barcelona’s academy to the first team

blocks.text: Lamine Yamal was born on 13 July 2007 and joined Barcelona’s academy from CF La Torreta at the age of seven. Barcelona’s [official player profile](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/futbol/primer-equip/jugadors/129404/lamine-yamal) describes his development.

He made his first-team debut against Real Betis on 29 April 2023. At 15 years, nine months and 16 days old, he became Barcelona’s youngest player to appear in La Liga. That league appearance was an important step from academy football into the senior professional game. See [Barcelona’s debut report](https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/3246834).

sections.title: Which match featured that curling goal?

blocks.text: On 9 July 2024, Spain faced France in the European Championship semi-final. France scored first, before Yamal struck from outside the penalty area in the 21st minute. His curling shot went in off the post to make it 1–1. Dani Olmo then scored, and Spain won 2–1. The timing and result can be checked in [UEFA’s match report](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/news/028f-1b544afc4a71-e17794a15449-1000--spain-2-1-france-la-roja-fight-back-to-reach-final/).

Yamal was 16 years and 362 days old when he scored, setting the record as the youngest goalscorer in EURO history. UEFA’s technical observers later selected the strike as [Goal of the Tournament](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/news/028f-1b61b696019f-f9f4c91eea25-1000--uefa-euro-2024-goal-of-the-tournament-lamine-yamal-tops-tec/). It was an equaliser in the semi-final, not a goal in the final.

sections.title: When watching again, look beyond the finish

blocks.text: Focus on three things: how he finds space to shoot after receiving the ball, how he adjusts his body before striking, and how the ball curves towards the far corner. Slow motion helps reveal the contact, while normal speed preserves the pressure from defenders and the difficulty of the timing. A single image of the ball going in cannot explain the whole attack.

One famous moment should not stand in for an entire tournament. Yamal recorded one goal and four assists in seven appearances at EURO 2024 and won Young Player of the Tournament. That award is distinct from Player of the Tournament. See the figures in [UEFA’s tournament review](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/news/028f-1b593529fcc2-02d376d78144-1000--lamine-yamal-s-record-breaking-euro-spain-prodigy-wins-f/).

sections.title: What match highlights and AI clips each show

blocks.text: To confirm which match Yamal played in and how a goal happened, start with official club and competition sources. An AI football clip is a creative work: the person in a photograph appears in a generated stadium scene. The footage does not prove they took part in a real match.

Ozil Goal uses a fixed football template. It has no custom action or prompt field and cannot recreate Yamal’s curling goal. You can make a football clip starring yourself; to learn about the player and goal behind the template’s name, read [the story of gol de ozil](/ozil-goal-generator/blog/gol-de-ozil).

sections.title: Make a football clip from one photo

items: Prepare one clear photo of a single adult whose image you have permission to use. Supported formats are JPG, PNG and WebP, with a maximum file size of 10MB.
Open the [Ozil Goal generator](/#generator) and upload the photo. Check that you have selected the right person and image, then review the generation details.
Each generation costs {ozilCredits} credits and produces a 15-second vertical 9:16 video with sound. See the [template guide](/ozil-goal-generator/ozil-goal-ai-template) for the settings.
Once it is ready, watch the entire video. Check the person’s face, the ball’s movement and the continuity of the actions before deciding whether to share it.

sections.title: Let viewers know it is a creation

blocks.text: A caption such as “I made an AI football clip from my own photo” gives useful context. Use the publishing platform’s AI content label when available. Do not describe generated footage as a recording of Yamal’s match or suggest that he took part in making it. Fan creativity comes from personal imagination, and explaining the source helps friends understand the clip.

faqs.question: When did Yamal score his famous goal against France?
faqs.answer: On 9 July 2024, in the European Championship semi-final. He equalised in the 21st minute, and Spain went on to win 2–1.

faqs.question: Can Ozil Goal generate Yamal’s curling finish?
faqs.answer: No. This site uses a fixed template. It does not let you specify a player’s moves, change the type of shot or enter a custom prompt.

faqs.question: Do I need to upload match footage to make a clip?
faqs.answer: No. The input is one photo of a single adult whose image you have permission to use. The output is an AI-generated football clip.
